title: Beyond the Event Horizon: An Operator-First Theory of Persistent Geometry and Black Hole Dynamics
summary: A black hole carries one wall of each kind. Its horizon is a geometric fold: in the right coordinate it is smooth, and nothing breaks there. Its innermost stable circular orbit is a spectral wall, a Jordan block where steady circling turns into a plunge. This paper builds both kinds of wall exactly in a setting where every step can be proved and computed, and then compares them, structurally, with black holes.
